note: index says whether search engines may list a copy: true (its own robots tags stand), false (the sync writes noindex into every page: noindex, follow, or noindex, nofollow where the owner's page already said nofollow) or "root-only" (only the entry page is listed). It is required, and `npm run sites` writes it into the copy. A todo beside it says the decision is still to be confirmed: until it is gone, the copy is left out of the main sitemap. path is the folder the sync replaces: sites/<name> or one plain folder of its own. formerHosts are hosts the portfolio used to live on: links to them in any copy are moved to the domain.
